Quick checklist from our side so we can create the vendor master cleanly:
1) Confirm legal entity exactly as it should appear on the vendor master (full legal name + DBA if any)
2) US Tax ID / EIN (formatted as 12-3456789 or similar)
3) Remit address for invoices (line1, line2, city, state, zip, country)
4) Primary AP contact (name, email, phone) and PO acceptance contact if different
5) Preferred invoice submission method (email to invoices@novapharm.co, portal upload, EDI)
6) Copies of W-9 and formation docs (received) — good to have the certificate dated within last 12 months if possible

Our flow: Laura will create a vendor master in our ERP once items 1–4 are confirmed and we have either a signed ACH/Banking form or a paper check option noted. Typical SLAs are 3 business days after receipt of all items. If you need faster routing for an open PO, mention the PO number and Priyom will escalate routing priorities.

I also attached a one-page intake form we use to normalize fields into our system (link below). Please fill and return to laura_bennett@redwood.com.
